sources.title: JamesBrewster/ChemReason_v1.0_8B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ChemReason is an 8B parameter language model fine-tuned for multi-task organic chemistry reasoning. It performs forward reaction prediction, retrosynthesis, mechanism explanation, synthesis planning, and yield estimation using chain-of-thought reasoning with <think> blocks followed by structured answers with SMILES notation.

sources.title: GitHub - RadeauDes/ChemReason
sources.snippet: ChemReason pairs a fine-tuned reasoning model (Qwen3.5-VL SFT) with a retrieve-and-cite backend over a corpus of 966,167 verified USPTO reactions. For chemistry that has been done before, it surfaces the actual documented reaction — reactants, product, conditions, patent, yield — rather than guessing.
